name: Sushant Bansal, Dy. IB Director
role: Deputy IB Director — Sanyal's operational deputy and Film 2 primary handler
real_life_inspiration: Composite/fictional. Represents the institutional machinery beneath Sanyal that carries out the Film 2 operational mandate. No single real-world parallel — likely a stand-in for the unnamed IB/RAW deputies who execute Doval-era covert doctrine.

inspiration_notes.role_in_film2: Sushant Bansal is the new addition in Film 2. With Sanyal elevated under the Naya Bharat mandate, Bansal handles the day-to-day operational management of the revenge arc — coordinating Hamza and Rizwan Shah's field operations.
inspiration_notes.institutional_function: In the Stackelberg hierarchy: Sanyal is the leader (commits to strategy), Bansal is the operational executor (translates strategy into field orders), Hamza/Rizwan are the on-ground responders. Bansal's role as middle layer is critical — he is the information broker between political direction and field reality.
inspiration_notes.oracle_classification: Playable in Film 2 turning points where the question is 'what orders should Bansal give Hamza/Rizwan?' rather than direct operative action.
